name: SpatialMed
description: Visual spatial intelligence is critical for medical image interpretation, yet remains largely unexplored in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for 3D imaging. This gap persists due to a systemic lack of datasets featuring structured 3D spatial annotations beyond basic labels. In this study, we introduce an agentic pipeline that autonomously synthesizes spatial visual question-answering (VQA) data by orchestrating computational tools such as volume estimation and bounding boxes extraction with multi-agent collaboration and expert radiologist validation.
